caption: The drawing features two distinct representations of a single cattle brand. In the top left quadrant, there is a detailed, colored illustration of a metal branding iron, shaped into a stylized combination of the letters "T" and "C" with the horizontal stroke of the "T" extending to the right and ending in an oval loop, which represents the handle of the branding iron. The metal appears textured and has a brown, copper-like coloration with visible shading to suggest a three-dimensional form. Below and slightly to the right, there is a flat, monochromatic depiction of the brand's mark in a light tan or sepia tone, matching the design formed by the branding iron above. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or cream color, and faint yellow lines are present between the two representations, suggesting alignment or emphasis. The artist's signature, "Elizabeth Johnson," is written in small text at the bottom right of the composition.
title: Branding Iron
